program: Wingless low-support fallback counterfactual loss attribution under fixed budget
question: Why did disabling the low-support fallback reduce total code-target exact hits from 11 to 8 while leaving the 21 raw class-5/6 selected-query exact hits unchanged at 2?
hypothesis: Replay the exact R7 training data, 15,819-byte budget, 256 motifs, 8x32 classes, 1,454-byte code target, depth-3 cap, baseline B11 full repaired bridge and candidate B01 exact-context-only bridge. Add attribution only. For each of the 63 frozen target queries, record baseline/candidate exact-hit state and the initial pair support used at the query start. Freeze four transition categories: baseline_only_hit, candidate_only_hit, both_hit, neither_hit. Split baseline_only_hit and candidate_only_hit by pair support <3 versus >=3 and by membership in R7's frozen raw class-5/6 selected-query set. Supported requires complete accounting and that the net -3 exact-hit delta is fully explained by the frozen transition buckets, with no representation, bridge, data, capacity, threshold, runtime, or evaluator change.

portfolio_context.role: advisory-only; attribution only; future-data learning efficiency remains primary

prior_evidence.interpretation: The low-support fallback causes the R6 suppression pattern, but removing it harms overall exact prediction; the loss occurs outside the originally selected class-5/6 query subset.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

attribution.accounting_identity: baseline_only_hit_count - candidate_only_hit_count must equal 3 and baseline_hit_count - candidate_hit_count must equal 3

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes; all 63 queries receive exactly one frozen transition attribution; the net three-hit loss is exactly reconstructed; selected-query net hit delta remains zero and nonselected-query net hit delta is -3.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but the frozen support/selection transition accounting cannot reconstruct the R7 loss.
classification_rules.invalid: Any parent, authority, source, budget, representation, baseline/candidate identity, target-query identity, accounting, determinism, provenance, capacity, or qualification criterion fails.

successor_if_low_support_nonselected_dom.intent: test one frozen training-only conditional fallback rule that preserves the helpful low-support cases while avoiding the attributed suppressive cases; originating-task only, with later disjoint transfer required before retention

successor_otherwise.intent: factor the dominant transition/support bucket further before proposing another candidate mechanism

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter R7 data, budgets, 256 capacity, 8x32 classes, baseline/candidate variants, target queries, selected-query identity, support buckets, transition categories, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.
